title: Reference sets saved by the DAW for every mapped feature (fixtures, no audio)
description:
## Intent

Capture ground truth: reference sets saved by the DAW itself, covering everything the export will write.

## Steps

1. Generate the audio the reference sets point to: a throwaway script (scratchpad, not committed) writes a 4-bar 120 BPM click-plus-tone WAV (48 kHz, 16-bit) and a second, differently named WAV in a subfolder with the same file name, to see how the DAW collects clashing names.
2. The owner (manual, needs the DAW) saves these sets with "collect all and save":
   - `empty.als`: new set, nothing changed.
   - `clip.als`: one audio track, one arrangement clip, warped, 3 warp markers moved, transpose +5, detune -23 ct, gain -6 dB; a second clip reversed; a third in Re-Pitch mode; tempo 99.5, time signature 3/4, loop brace bars 1-4, two locators named `IV` and `V7`, scale set to F mixolydian if available.
   - `mix.als`: a group inside a group, a return track, a send at -12 dB, track volume +3 dB, pan 30 R.
   - `devices.als`: one track per stock device (EQ Eight with low cut, shelves and peaks; Compressor with sidechain from another track; Limiter; Saturator; Redux; Gate; Utility with width; Reverb; Delay synced and unsynced with ping pong; Auto Filter 12 dB low-pass), each with non-default values.
   - `automation.als`: envelopes on volume, pan, a send, EQ Eight high cut, Compressor dry/wet; one ramp and one step.
3. Record in a comment the DAW version used and whether the previous major version opens each set.

## Output

`crates/apricity-daw/tests/fixtures/reference/*.als` plus `README.md` there listing what each file contains and the regenerating script's parameters. No audio committed.

## Verification

`git ls-files crates/apricity-daw/tests/fixtures` lists only `.als` and `.md`; `gunzip -t` succeeds on each `.als`.

## Release

`chore(<this task's id>): reference sets for the DAW set format`. Not a breaking change.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Started. The DAW is not on this Mac; per the epic's 'Not blocked on the DAW' comment I am gathering public .als files (permissively licensed repos only go into fixtures, others are cited from the scratchpad) and writing the owner's click-by-click save instructions for the licensed install.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Found DAW-saved sets in public repos (cloned to scratchpad, parsed as data only). Current-major evidence: 12.0b16, 12.1d1, 12.1.11, 12.2, 12.2.1, 12.2.6, 12.3.2, 12.3.7, 12.4.5b10. Permissively licensed and chosen for fixtures: a 12.3.7 minimal set (MIT, github.com/reasonno1, repo id 1226932927), two 12.2/12.2.1 user sets (MIT, github.com/owenbush, repo id 1074927552). GPL-3 (abletoolz skeletons, DawVert device dataset), AGPL and unlicensed repos are cited only. Repo names contain the vendor word, so the note cites them by owner + GitHub repository id + commit + blob SHA. Gaps no public 12.x file covers: Gate and Redux XML (11.0.12 and GPL dataset only), reversed clips, clashing collected file names, clip fades units. Those go on the owner's save list.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Machine side done; the owner's sets are still needed, so this stays in_progress.

- Fixtures: crates/apricity-daw/tests/fixtures/reference/set/ holds public-12.3.7-minimal.als, public-12.2.1-techno.als, public-12.2-broom-bap.als (MIT, byte-identical to the published files, git blob ids in the README) and README.md (sources, licence notices, what each set shows). gunzip -t passes on all three.
- Audio generator: scripts/daw-reference-audio.py (stdlib, deterministic; the same sha256 on two runs) writes click-tone.wav and clash/click-tone.wav into the git-ignored renders/daw-reference/. Nothing under fixtures is audio.
- Remaining (needs the DAW): the owner saves empty/clip/mix/devices/automation following design/daw-set.md 'Owner steps' (click by click), then they are copied here per 'Re-check when the licensed install arrives'. The owner also records the DAW version. The previous major version cannot open a 12 set (structural 11 to 12 break), so that check is moot.
